why: Exactly the shape that shipped before issue #324's step S7: releasing the slot resets the relaunch target and the topbar status, and leaves every OTHER retained gameplay member holding the match that just ended. `hud.ts` keeps whatever it was last told, so the visible result is a finished match's outcome tally, a frozen 3-2-1 countdown chip, the `?dev=1&shellCount=1` readout and the player's last touch thumbs, all sitting over the Main Menu until something else overwrites them. Invisible to every pre-S7 assertion, which is why it is pinned separately from the entry above rather than folded into it: that one drops the whole reset and this one drops only the half S7 added. Pinned with killedBy rather than a count -- the claim is which members are emptied, not a population.
